name: junco-tools
description: Pi bash operations backed by marsh ShellMux

scripts.build:native: node scripts/with-junco-build-env.mjs napi build --platform --release --esm --output-dir native --js index.js --dts index.d.ts -- --locked
scripts.build:native:test: node scripts/with-junco-build-env.mjs napi build --platform --esm --features test-fs --output-dir target/native-test --js index.js --dts index.d.ts -- --locked
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts
